sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium columbianum, plant_name_id 279953.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Lilium columbianum: stems 60 cm to 1.2 m tall. The scan's text reads cm, which the plant's own parts show is a misreading of dm; FNA: stems to 1.7 m. The typical value is the one the plant was drawn at before, inside the source's range. Its reference height is that typical value, 1.0 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Lilium columbianum: stems 60 cm to 1.2 m tall. The scan's text reads cm, which the plant's own parts show is a misreading of dm; FNA: stems to 1.7 m. The typical value is the one the plant was drawn at before, inside the source's range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Lilium columbianum: leaves 5 cm to 10 cm long; FNA: 1.7-15.7 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 0.4-4.7 cm wide, 2.4-7.4 times longer than wide; drawn at the narrower of its usual widths for Abrams' 5-10 cm length.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams, Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States vol. 1 (1923), Lilium columbianum: leaves in whorls, the uppermost and lowest ones scattered.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), Lilium columbianum: whorls of 5 to 9 leaves, sometimes more (FNA: 3-25); 6 is the count this spec drew by hand before, within that range.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade weakly oblanceolate to obovate or more or less elliptic

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves usually ascending

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves in 1-9 whorls or partial whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences racemose, 1-25(-45)-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers pendent to nodding

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth Turk's-cap-shaped; sepals and petals reflexed 2/5-1/2 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): reflexed 2/5-1/2 along length from base

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): yellow or orange to occasionally red; drawn orange The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): with copious maroon spots

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): maroon spots The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals 3.4-7.1 cm, petals 3.5-6.9 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens barely to moderately exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers pale yellow to yellow The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 2.8-20.2 cm. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 2.2-5.4 x 1.1-2 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1.1-2 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering summer (early May-early Aug)

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium columbianum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems to 1.7 m

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: capsules ripening in August and September.
